Oh! What a Lovely Tour | Oh!  What a Lovely Tour is a CD/DVD package by the British indie rock band Babyshambles released on 2 June 2008.  It is the first live album of the band.  The concert was recorded during the winter leg of the UK arena tour at the SECC Glasgow on 1 December 2007.  In addition to the concert film edited and directed by Giorgio Testi, the DVD also contains the music videos for "The Blinding", "Love You But You're Green", "Delivery" and "You Talk".
You Are What You Eat (film) | You Are What You Eat is a 1968 American counterculture semi-documentary movie that attempts to capture the essence of the 1960s flower power hippie era and the Haight-Ashbury scene.  The film features locally known personalities, including well known and somewhat mythical pot dealer Super Spade and musicians of the day including Tiny Tim, David Crosby and Peter Yarrow etc. and radio disc jockey, Rosko.
